cookie.name: jev_router_session
cookie.secure: HTTPS public origin; loopback HTTP exception

source: Exact configured Origin and Host; cookie GET may omit Origin. Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin when present. All cookie POSTs require JSON and session-bound X-CSRF-Token; login requires Settings Bearer instead.
precedence: A present Authorization selects Bearer without cookie fallback; status/logout reject Authorization. Inference accepts Bearer only.
lifecycle: Fixed expiry, no sliding renewal. Logout revokes only the request session. Same Settings/origin restart preserves sessions; changes invalidate all old generations permanently.
retry: Do not retry login automatically; resolve unknown outcome through status. Never replay business writes after authentication failure. Never fetch a newer CSRF token to retry stale logout.
